subject: Error: studyname not specified in part1. Needed for analysing lists of files

messages.author: 38a39010d549c142
messages.subject: Error: studyname not specified in part1. Needed for analysing lists of files
parts:
Hi all,

I am working with raw GENEactiv csv file with the latest GGIR update. The raw csv file contains details about the device and data in the first few rows as shown in the attachments.  On running the code shown below with and without those rows, I get the following error: Error: studyname not specified in part1. Needed for analysing lists of files. 

Can someone help me specifying the studyname? What am I doing wrong? Is there another way to do this?

library(GGIR)
g.shell.GGIR(
             mode=c(1,2,3,4,5),
             datadir="study_1/C4_049316.csv",
             outputdir="/Users/apoorvasrinivasan/Desktop/hanga galfalvy/actigraphy",
             do.report=c(2,4,5),
             #=====================
             # Part 2
             #=====================
             strategy = 1,
             hrs.del.start = 0,          hrs.del.end = 0,
             maxdur = 9,                 includedaycrit = 16,
             qwindow=c(0,24),
             mvpathreshold =c(100),
             bout.metric = 4,
             excludefirstlast = FALSE,
             includenightcrit = 16,
             #=====================
             # Part 3 + 4
             #=====================
             def.noc.sleep = 1,
             outliers.only = TRUE,
             criterror = 4,
             do.visual = TRUE,
             #=====================
             # Part 5
             #=====================
             threshold.lig = c(30), threshold.mod = c(100),  threshold.vig = c(400),
             boutcriter = 0.8,      boutcriter.in = 0.9,     boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
             boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8, boutdur.in = c(1,10,30), boutdur.lig = c(1,10),
             boutdur.mvpa = c(1),
             #=====================
             # Visual report
             #=====================
             timewindow = c("WW"),
             visualreport=TRUE)


Thanks,
Apoorva

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: Error: studyname not specified in part1. Needed for analysing lists of files
parts:
Hi Apoorva,

You can specify study name by adding "studyname = 'here your study name'" in your list of arguments.

Best,
Jairo
